items.title: Adopt the canonical source after review
items.currentEvidence: The user approved local adoption and synchronization of all foundation files and documents. The master is now authoritative; TypeScript APIs, raw references, CSS and marked documentation tables are generated from it. Consumer application validation and explicitly deferred work remain separate.
items.nextStep: Edit the canonical collection, rebuild and validate. Test consuming applications before product launch.

items.title: Shared spacing names and reference layer
items.currentEvidence: User approved ref.space.<px> references and rds.space.<Spectrum index> shared aliases for the entire spacing scale. All 16 positive mappings match the linked Spectrum table; zero preserves Rahino's existing reset.
items.nextStep: All 17 reference/shared pairs are applied. Migrate old public token/CSS names using Spacing-Migration.md before release.

items.title: Veil group and leaf declarations
items.currentEvidence: All six veil names are groups, each containing a .color token and a .blur token. TypeScript leaf annotations, Markdown paths and master groups agree.
items.nextStep: Group/leaf contract applied. All six treatment values and existing exports remain unchanged.

items.title: Chart slot public paths
items.currentEvidence: All 18 chart colors now have stable public leaf names: categorical.01–08, sequential.01–05 and diverging.01–05. Existing zero-based arrays are derived in that exact order.
items.nextStep: Naming and comments aligned. Palette values, theme pairs, series order and existing array exports are preserved.

resolution.legacyArrays: Retained as derived ordered projections; index 0 maps to public slot 01.

items.title: Dark control-boundary contrast
items.currentEvidence: The user approved reusing #7A8493 / ref.color.gray-cool.450 for the dark control boundary. It exceeds 3:1 on all six defined dark surfaces; raised is about 3.807:1. The light boundary and focus ring are unchanged.
items.nextStep: Use the approved boundary where it is needed to identify a control. Validate actual component adjacency during component work.

items.title: Control and state identifying cues
items.currentEvidence: The user assigned identification and state cues to each component and excluded this from foundation decision blockers.
items.nextStep: Specify and test the identifying cue during component design; preserve the general rule against communicating a state through color alone.

deferral.resumeWhen: Each affected control, selection or feedback component is designed.

items.title: Calculated contrast references stay synchronized
items.currentEvidence: All 30 light/dark INK/SURFACE reference figures are recomputed from the source colors. The three stale light-canvas entries are corrected to 14.19, 5.88 and 4.80. Color.ts now calculates the reference export automatically; the master reference is synchronized.
items.nextStep: Recompute and synchronize the master derived reference after any approved palette change; the checker rejects stale figures. Remaining control-boundary decisions do not prevent accurate current calculations.
items.userInstruction: User will review the dark-mode contrast problem; update the contrasts after it is resolved.

items.title: Reading width conflict
items.currentEvidence: Layout, Typography and TypeScript now use one 42rem reading cap (672px at a 16px root). The 48rem preset is retired; its old name is a deprecated alias to reading.
items.nextStep: Use the canonical reading token for all long-form text. Retain the deprecated wide alias only until external consumers migrate, then remove it in the next breaking release.

resolution.rationale: Preserve Rahino's existing default measure, follow rem typography units, allow browser-default text resizing and container reflow. No universal standard mandates exactly 42rem.

compatibilityAlias.removalPlan: Use rds.type.layout.measure.reading. Remove this compatibility alias in the next breaking release after external consumer migration is verified; no new usage.

items.title: Typography bundles and fluid sizes
items.currentEvidence: The user authorized a simple resolution. All 16 roles use their existing property bindings and Persian/English font bindings as style recipes. The two clamp() sizes remain exact CSS expressions. Letter spacing is omitted, preserving current inherited behavior; no new spacing value is introduced.
items.nextStep: Use the recipe assembler for complete styles. Integrate platform outputs during canonical adoption; retain the existing Typography.ts APIs and appearance.

items.title: Reading-paragraph spacing recipe
items.currentEvidence: The existing 1em gap is approved for consecutive reading paragraphs only. It follows paragraph font size; interface-element gaps use the shared spacing scale. Documentation, TypeScript annotations and master recipe metadata agree.
items.nextStep: Keep the existing value and public export. Retain the rule outside ordinary DTCG dimensions and generate the same CSS during canonical adoption; verify actual-font readability and user spacing overrides in consumers.

resolution.representation: CSS recipe outside ordinary DTCG dimension tokens
resolution.scope: consecutive reading paragraphs in articles, reports and multi-paragraph help text

items.title: Presentation artwork representation
items.currentEvidence: Three preserved CSS recipes now use rds.color.presentation.gradient.* names. Brand light/dark remain approved variants of one theme-following background; final gradient representation, the theme-neutral role and output generation remain deferred to design.
items.nextStep: During presentation design work, preserve complete gradient instructions and implement the approved theme-following brand role. Keep current artwork and exports until that migration; separately review the atmosphere recipe without inferring new theme behavior.

deferral.userInstruction: Mark this to be completed later down the road while designing.
deferral.resumeWhen: Presentation backgrounds are designed or revised.
deferral.scope: Complete gradient instructions alongside their colors

items.title: Resolver rules
items.currentEvidence: System appearance is the default, explicit app selection overrides it, and light is the fallback if the system preference is unavailable. Contrast is independent; native forced colors override custom palettes. The ten existing enhanced-contrast fields have explicit semantic targets. Content script remains explicit.
items.nextStep: Use context-policy.json and scripts/context.mjs for selection. Applications subscribe to preferences and implement forced-color CSS; output integration follows canonical adoption.

items.title: Shared layout token exports
items.currentEvidence: Twelve approved shared layout paths are stored in the master collection and generated into layout.ts. Existing breakpoints, columns, gutters, margins and the 1600px cap are preserved; spacing values alias shared tokens.
items.nextStep: Use the generated layout exports and existing typography reading token. Keep responsive composition and number formatting as documented rules; regenerate layout.ts after master changes.

items.title: Number profile configuration contract
items.currentEvidence: Six profiles are named; precise product configuration and required fields are not defined here.
items.nextStep: Define profile configuration and product defaults during number-formatting implementation; preserve existing Numbers.md rules.

items.title: Motion validation phase is explicit
items.currentEvidence: The foundation owner confirmed phase one visual testing in Figma is completed. Motion.md, Motion.ts and master metadata now agree. Qipper implementation testing remains pending.
items.nextStep: Complete implementation, accessibility and performance checks in real Qipper components before release; do not infer those results from Figma validation.

items.title: Color references use the approved local source set

Claims about an unavailable comparison table, external repository, Light/Dark token files, css.ts migration, icon aliases and nonexistent edge.focus alias are removed or replaced. Color values and all runtime exports are unchanged.
items.nextStep: Use the approved local definitions and recorded master review status. Do not restore unverified external migration claims. Existing real aliases and deferred presentation artwork remain intact.

resolution.sourcePolicy: Approved foundation files in the current folder

items.title: Mechanical documentation defects
items.currentEvidence: Completed the scheduled cleanup after foundation decisions were resolved or explicitly deferred: repaired malformed Border tables, removed stale draft/source claims, linked Numbers typography locally, clarified unchanged letter spacing, and generated foundation value tables.
items.nextStep: Maintain guidance in the Markdown files and regenerate marked value tables from the master.

items.title: Explicit font binding for every typography role
items.currentEvidence: The font policy already existed, but 15 base roles delegated font selection to consumers. TYPOGRAPHY_BY_SCRIPT now derives complete Persian and English styles for all 16 roles, reusing the approved font tokens and retaining the code override.
items.nextStep: Use the resolved style exports where a complete style is needed. Applications still load the fonts and choose script/direction per text run. Existing base exports and metrics remain unchanged; final DTCG typography representation is still open.

items.title: Brand background follows the active theme
items.currentEvidence: The user confirmed one brand background that automatically changes with the theme, rather than two independently selected artworks.
items.nextStep: Implement one theme-neutral brand background role and map the preserved light/dark artwork to the active appearance during the deferred presentation design work. Keep the atmosphere recipe separate; no new atmosphere behavior is implied.

items.title: Three shadow levels; lg is the modal shadow
items.currentEvidence: The owner confirmed the Veil & Shadow document edits and explicitly requested removal of xlg and use of lg for modals. Shadow.ts and both master appearances contain only sm, md and lg; specifications agree.
items.nextStep: Use lg for modal and confirmation dialogs. Replace any former xlg reference with lg using Shadow-Migration.md. All approved local source references have been checked; no compatibility alias is retained because removal was explicitly requested.

items.title: Lighter dark focus ring
items.currentEvidence: The user approved #A9638B for the dark focus ring. The light ring remains #99507A. Full-precision checks exceed 3:1 against all six defined dark appearance surfaces.
items.nextStep: Use the new dark ring with the existing focus geometry. Validate adjacent colors in each component; do not infer suitability for every arbitrary fill.

items.title: Explicit raw references beneath shared roles

items.nextStep: Synchronize foundation TypeScript and Markdown from the approved master structure in the next stage. Keep unresolved fluid/letter-spacing/context decisions and deferred gradient work separate.

items.title: Color references use hue families and numbered steps

All 124 raw color values are preserved; 123 paths are renamed and white retains its endpoint name. Shared roles, themes, chart ordering, contrast and the three shadow levels are unchanged.
items.nextStep: Use the new references. Keep the historical inventory unchanged and apply its recorded rename mapping during validation. Add colors only for real requirements or a reviewed scale; keep existing step IDs stable.

items.nextStep: Edit typography.json for role definitions, typed token JSON for reference values, and Markdown for guidance. Rebuild generated outputs.

items.nextStep: Apply the ink and material guidance in consuming components. Validate final combinations on their actual backgrounds.

items.currentEvidence: The diverging midpoint can have insufficient contrast against the plot when used as an essential mark. User explicitly deferred this audit follow-up item.
items.nextStep: During chart design, validate essential marks against plot backgrounds and choose suitable outlines, labels or other redundant encoding without recoloring the palette by default.

items.title: Shared generated color resolver
items.currentEvidence: User authorized a framework-independent resolver and interference checks. It shares appearance/contrast precedence and forced-color mapping with existing selectors and CSS; browser preference handling is opt-in.
items.nextStep: Import the generated module and tokens.css in consuming applications. Apply saved preferences before rendering; dispose browser subscriptions on teardown.

items.title: Primary fills use on-brand ink
items.currentEvidence: User requested rds.color.ink.on-brand for primary fills and excluded ordinary ink.primary from that role. Primary-action foreground aliases on-brand in both themes; standard color values remain unchanged.
items.nextStep: Use ink.on-brand on enabled solid primary fills. Keep ink.primary on neutral surfaces and brand.fg on soft brand tints.
